desc: Derive the exact edge-bit equations for Type A and Type B tiles, including toroidal wraparound and all index conventions.

Prove that horizontal edge variables reduce to one binary variable per row and vertical edge variables to one binary variable per column, including the necessary even-parity checks on every row and column.
Formulate each Type B cell as a parity equation between its row and column variables, and prove Type A cells impose no further constraints.
Design a parity DSU over \(H+W\) variables to detect contradictions and count connected components.
Specify an \(O(HW)\)-time, \(O(H+W)\)-memory implementation, including modular exponentiation and input handling for all test cases.
Validate the complete algorithm against the provided samples and edge cases such as all-A, all-B, and odd row/column parity instances.
